broker.name: JustMarkets
broker.tagline: Its site names 5 regulators, including FSA (Seychelles), CySEC, and FSCA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:3000.
broker.about: The JustMarkets pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Standard, Standard Cent, Pro, and Raw Spread. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, WebTrader, iOS, and Android. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles), CySEC, FSCA, FSC (Mauritius), and FSC (BVI). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:3000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: The deposit guide and the account comparison table list Standard and Standard Cent at 10 USD and Pro and Raw Spread at 200 USD. A quick-start page instead says Standard and Standard Cent from $1 and Pro and Raw Spread from $100, and says the minimum may also depend on the payment system. Because the figures differ by account and by page, no single minimum is stored.

other_fees.label: Deposit and withdrawal commission
other_fees.note: The deposit page says JustMarkets does not impose fees on deposits or withdrawals. Banks and payment systems may charge their own fees. Homepage says instant processing from JustMarkets within 1 minute, with possible provider delays.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, regulations, deposit guide, professional accounts, demo account comparison, and quick-start pages loaded. https://justmarkets.com/trading/account-types returned 404. No founding year or headquarters city was on the pages fetched. Homepage says no overnight charges for all clients, while the professional accounts page says swap-free is available for Muslims and for clients with Extended swap-free level, and that conversion is requested via support. A promotions URL was seen in search but that page was not fetched, so no promotion is recorded.
